controles.affirmation: Une hausse de l'AUC/A de 18% portee presque entierement par la remontee des marches et non par de nouveaux clients (hook) / hausse dominee par l'appreciation des marches plutot que par la conquete de nouveaux clients
controles.verbatim_source: "AUC/A of $57.86 trillion as of June 30, 2026, increased 18% compared to June 30, 2025, primarily due to higher market levels, client flows and net new business."
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q cite explicitement trois causes, dont les flux clients ET le net new business. "Presque entierement" et "non par de nouveaux clients" contredisent le document. Reecrire : "une hausse tiree en premier lieu par les niveaux de marche, mais aussi par les flux clients et la nouvelle activite". A noter egalement, omis par l'ATT : 2,93 T$ de mandats restent a installer au 30 juin 2026, dont environ 65% attendus d'ici fin 2026.

controles.affirmation: Sur les 8 derniers trimestres, la moyenne des nouveaux mandats AUC/A ressort a 530 Mds $
controles.correction_proposee: La moyenne des 8 derniers trimestres (T3-2024 a T2-2026) est de 555 Mds $, pas 530. La fenetre T2-2024 a T1-2026 donne 543 Mds $. Aucune fenetre de 8 trimestres ne donne 530 Mds $. Corriger a 555 Mds $ dans le bloc quantitatif ET dans "ce_qui_affaiblirait" (la conclusion "le T2 2026 reste en dessous" demeure valide).

controles.affirmation: Cette politique a ete approuvee a 93% par les actionnaires lors du vote consultatif Say on Pay 2026
controles.verbatim_source: DEF 14A 2026 : "We met with shareholders both before and after our 2025 “Say on Pay” vote, which received approximately 93% support at our annual meeting."
controles.correction_proposee: Les 93% correspondent au vote Say on Pay de 2025, pas de 2026. Remplacer par "vote consultatif Say on Pay 2025 (environ 93% de soutien)".

controles.affirmation: Nouvelle emission d'actions privilegiees deux semaines apres la cloture du trimestre
controles.verbatim_source: Prospectus 424B5 date du 5 aout 2026 ; trimestre clos le 30 juin 2026 ; 10-Q depose le 30 juillet 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Il s'ecoule environ cinq semaines entre la cloture du trimestre (30 juin) et le prospectus (5 aout), et six jours apres le depot du 10-Q. Reecrire : "cinq semaines apres la cloture du trimestre" ou "six jours apres le depot du 10-Q".

controles.affirmation: Poursuite antitrust : en novembre 2024, onze procureurs generaux d'Etats ont depose plainte devant la cour federale du district Est du Texas contre State Street et deux autres gestionnaires, pour entente visant a restreindre artificiellement l'offre de charbon
controles.verbatim_source: "In November 2024, eleven state Attorneys General filed a complaint in Federal Court in the Eastern District of Texas against State Street and two other large investment management firms, alleging antitrust violations on the theory that the firms conspired to artificially suppress coal supply, resulting in harm to American consumers in the form of higher electricity costs."

controles.affirmation: Litige fiscal allemand : controle 2013-2015, State Street aurait du retenir et reste secondairement responsable de certains impots sur dividendes de titres allemands detenus en collateral, montant non chiffre
controles.verbatim_source: "In connection with a routine audit including the period 2013-2015, German tax authorities have determined that State Street should have withheld, and is secondarily liable for, certain taxes on dividends paid on securities of German issuers held as collateral over dividend record dates in client lending transactions with counterparties outside of Germany. This determination is subject to review in proceedings in which State Street will in due course contest these conclusions, in addition to separately seeking relief from those determined to be primarily liable."

controles.affirmation: 384 Mds $ de nouveaux mandats AUC/A au T2 2026 contre 1 090 Mds $ au T2 2025, soit -65% ; AUC/A total 57 860 Mds $ (+18%)
controles.verbatim_source: "In the second quarter of 2026, newly announced investment servicing mandates totaled approximately $384 billion of AUC/A" ; "AUC/A of $57.86 trillion as of June 30, 2026, increased 18% compared to June 30, 2025" ; kpis-haut : Q2-2025 = 1,09 T$ (384/1090 - 1 = -64,8%)

controles.affirmation: CET1 a 10,8% au 30 juin 2026, en hausse de 10 points de base sur un an, loin du pic de 14,3% de fin 2021 ; minimum reglementaire incluant surcharges de 8,0%
controles.verbatim_source: "Our standardized CET1 capital ratio decreased to 10.8% as of June 30, 2026, compared to 11.6% as of December 31, 2025" ; "This results in minimum risk-based ratios of 8.0% for the common equity tier 1 (CET1) capital ratio" ; kpis-haut : Q2-2025 = 10,7 ; Q4-2021 = 14,3
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance facultative : le 10-Q explique la baisse par rapport a fin 2025 par "a normalization in RWA from episodically low levels at December 31, 2025 and continued capital return", explication absente de l'ATT.

controles.affirmation: Revenu total +17%, resultat net +56%, ROE 16,7% au T2 2026 ; actions privilegiees en circulation 3 559 M$ ; offre Series L en cours
controles.verbatim_source: "Total revenue increased 17% in the second quarter of 2026" ; "Net income | $ 1,084 | $ 693 | 56" ; "return on equity of 16.7% in the second quarter of 2026 increased from 10.8%" ; "Preferred stock | 3,559" ; 424B5 : "State Street Corporation is offering depositary shares, each representing a 1/100th ownership interest in a share of our Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series L"

controles.affirmation: Ratio de remuneration PDG/salarie median de 449x (19,53 M$ pour Ronald P. O'Hanley contre 43 491 $), remuneration en hausse de 16,8%, dont 12,76 M$ en attributions d'actions liees a la performance
controles.verbatim_source: DEF 14A 2026 : "the estimated median of the annual total compensation of all employees of State Street (other than Mr. O'Hanley), was $43,491" ; "the annual total compensation of Mr. O'Hanley was $19,529,070" ; "the ratio [...] is estimated to be 449 to 1" ; Summary Compensation Table 2025 : salaire 1 200 000, stock awards 12 764 924, non-equity 5 399 375, autre 164 771, total 19 529 070 ; total 2024 = 16 715 967 (+16,8%)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : la ligne "Stock Awards" de 12,76 M$ regroupe des CRSU, des DSA et des RSU de performance ; ecrire "attributions d'actions" plutot que "attributions d'actions liees a la performance".
